player.whyMonitoringBody: This is a graded assessment, so Sentinel confirms it's you doing the work — that's what makes the credential you earn trustworthy to others.
player.privacyBody: Everything runs on your device. No video, audio, or images are ever recorded, stored, or sent anywhere — only an integrity score. The camera is optional and you can turn it off at any time.

player.feedbackIntro: Tell the instructor what helped and what could be clearer. Your feedback may be used to improve this lesson.

player.feedbackSaved: Your latest feedback for this lesson was saved.
player.tutorIntro: Ask about this lesson using a model you provide. The tutor is unavailable during assessments.
player.tutorLocalDisclosure: {provider} runs at the local endpoint you configured. Lesson text stays on your device.
player.tutorCloudDisclosure: Lesson text, conversation, and your question are sent to {provider} using your API key.
